entities.summary: Wendy Mary Beckett, better known as Sister Wendy, was a British Catholic religious sister and art historian who became known internationally during the 1990s when she presented a series of BBC television documentaries on the history of art. Her programmes, such as Sister Wendy's Odyssey and Sister Wendy's Grand Tour, often drew a 25 percent share of the British viewing audience. In 1997 she made her debut on US public television, with The New York Times describing her as "a sometime hermit who is fast on her way to becoming the most unlikely and famous art critic in the history of television."

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent art historian and television presenter, Sister Wendy's documentaries reached over 100 million viewers worldwide, making her one of the most-watched art historians in history. Her programs had a significant impact on popularizing art history and inspiring new generations of artists and art enthusiasts.
